AI/ML Intern (Generative AI, Agentic AI & Machine Learning) @ Estroc (DL, IN)
job.description:
AI/ML Intern (Generative AI, Agentic AI & Machine Learning)

**Company:** ESTROC  
**Website:** https://estroc.co.in  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Compensation:** Starting from ₹10,000 per month  
**Duration:** 3–6 Months  
**Work Mode:** Remote (India) | Hybrid coordination in Delhi NCR  
**Working Hours:** Flexible, approximately 30 hours per week  
**Start Date:** Immediate  
**Experience:** Students, Freshers and Candidates with 0–1 Year Experience

About the Internship

ESTROC is looking for curious, technically motivated AI/ML Interns who want to build real-world intelligent applications and contribute to modern AI-powered products.

This internship offers hands-on exposure to Machine Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, Computer Vision and intelligent automation.

You will work on practical engineering assignments, internal products and client-oriented projects, collaborating with the development team to research, build, test, integrate and deploy AI-powered solutions.

We value practical problem-solving, experimentation and the willingness to learn over simply knowing a long list of technologies.

Areas of Work (Priority)

Candidates may express interest in one or more areas:

* **Generative AI & LLM Engineering:** LLM applications, prompt engineering, model integration and AI-powered assistants.
* **Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems:** AI agents, tool calling, autonomous workflows and intelligent automation.
* **Machine Learning & Deep Learning:** Model development, training, evaluation, experimentation and optimization.
* **RAG & Knowledge Systems:** Document processing, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search and retrieval pipelines.
* **Computer Vision & NLP:** Image processing, OCR, object detection, text analytics and language-based applications.
* **AI Engineering & MLOps:** Model serving, API integration, deployment, monitoring and scalable AI infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, test and integrate Machine Learning and AI-powered applications.
* Build LLM-based applications, AI assistants, chatbots and intelligent automation workflows.
* Experiment with open-source and commercial AI models and APIs.
* Develop RAG pipelines using document processing, embeddings, vector databases and semantic retrieval.
* Build and experiment with AI agents, LangChain, LangGraph and multi-agent workflows.
* Work on data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training and evaluation.
* Explore computer vision, OCR, NLP and deep learning applications.
* Develop backend services and REST APIs for AI model integration.
* Assist in deploying AI solutions using cloud platforms and containerized environments.
* Debug, evaluate and optimize model performance, accuracy, latency and reliability.
* Maintain clean, reusable and well-documented code using Git and GitHub.
* Research emerging AI technologies and implement relevant proof-of-concepts.
* Collaborate with frontend, backend and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into complete applications.

Technical Skills & Preferred Technologies

**Programming & Data Science**

* Python
* NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
* Scikit-learn
* Data preprocessing and feature engineering
* SQL and database fundamentals

**Machine Learning & Deep Learning**

* TensorFlow or PyTorch
* Supervised and unsupervised learning
* Neural networks and model evaluation
* Computer Vision and NLP fundamentals

**Generative AI & Agentic Systems**

* OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Groq and other LLM APIs
* Prompt Engineering
* LangChain and LangGraph
* Agentic workflows and tool calling
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Embeddings and vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma or Qdrant

**Backend, APIs & Cloud**

* FastAPI or Flask
* REST API development and integration
* Docker and Git/GitHub
* AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Model deployment and basic MLOps concepts

Candidates are not expected to know every technology. Strong Python fundamentals, basic ML understanding, curiosity and the ability to build and explain projects are more important.

What You'll Learn

* Building real-world AI and ML applications.
* Developing and integrating LLM-powered systems.
* Designing RAG pipelines and intelligent knowledge systems.
* Building Agentic AI and multi-agent workflows.
* Working with computer vision, NLP and deep learning.
* Model evaluation, optimization and deployment.
* Cloud-based AI application development.
* API engineering and full-stack AI integration.
* Git collaboration, software architecture and engineering practices.
* Working on practical product and client-oriented requirements.

Who Should Apply?

We welcome applications from:

* B.Tech / B.E. students in Computer Science, IT, AI/ML, Electronics or related disciplines.
* MCA, M.Sc. Computer Science, Data Science and related students.
* Recent graduates and freshers interested in AI engineering.
* Candidates with personal, academic or open-source AI/ML projects.
* Developers interested in transitioning into Generative AI and intelligent automation.

**Ideal candidates are:**

* Comfortable with Python and programming fundamentals.
* Familiar with basic Machine Learning concepts.
* Interested in experimenting with new AI frameworks and models.
* Capable of researching, debugging and solving technical problems.
* Willing to learn independently and collaborate with a development team.

Internship Details & Benefits

* Stipend **₹10,000 per month**, depending on skills and selection.
* Flexible internship duration of 2–6 months.
* Remote work opportunities across India.
* Flexible working schedule.
* Hands-on exposure to real-world software and AI projects.
* Mentorship and technical collaboration.
* Opportunity to contribute to live product development and client-oriented assignments.
* Internship Completion Certificate upon successful completion.
* Letter of Recommendation based on performance and contribution.
* Potential consideration for extended or full-time opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated resume (PDF).
* GitHub profile (preferred).
* LinkedIn profile (optional).
* Links to AI/ML projects, GitHub repositories, research work or portfolio (if available).
* Brief description of their preferred AI/ML domain and technical interests.

**Location:** Remote, India | Delhi NCR hybrid coordination where required.

**ESTROC — We Build What Comes Next.**  
https://estroc.co.in

Pay: ₹10,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New Delhi, Delhi 110088

job.title: Java Technical Lead @ Citi (MH, IN)
job.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Applications Development Technical Lead (C13 / VP)** is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the architectural design, engineering roadmap, and technical execution of mission-critical, enterprise-scale software platforms. This role serves as the principal technical authority for backend systems powered by **Java**, **Spring Boot / Spring Cloud**, **distributed microservices**, and **event-driven architectures**.

The individual will lead technical teams, define architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives (cloud migration, containerization, performance engineering), and act as the primary liaison between engineering teams, enterprise architects, and senior business stakeholders. The role demands deep technical mastery, strategic vision, high autonomy, and a strong track record of delivering resilient, low-latency, and highly available financial systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Technical Leadership & System Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the Lead Architect / Technical Authority across core banking platforms, defining high-level system designs, domain models, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Direct the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and resilient **Java/Spring Boot microservices** capable of processing high-volume, low-latency transactions.
* Champion modern engineering paradigms including **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** using Apache Kafka, asynchronous messaging, and distributed caching strategies.
* Drive technical debt reduction, legacy modernization, and application refactoring initiatives to enhance maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**2. Engineering Governance, DevOps & Operational Resilience**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Establish and enforce software engineering standards, coding guidelines, API governance, and automated code quality gates across multi-disciplinary squads.
* Drive the adoption of cloud-native deployment patterns and container orchestration across **OpenShift, Kubernetes**
* Define end-to-end CI/CD delivery strategies, infrastructure-as-code practices, automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime release workflows (Blue/Green, Canary).
* Architect for high availability (HA), fault tolerance, disaster recovery (DR/COB), and resilience patterns (circuit breaking, bulkhead isolation, rate limiting).
* Lead performance tuning, heap/thread dump analysis, distributed tracing, and capacity planning for mission-critical production systems.

**3. Security, Risk & Compliance Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------

* Embed "Secure-by-Design" principles across all software layers, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise security standards, OWASP top 10 guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Architect robust identity and access management (IAM), OAuth2/OIDC implementations, mTLS communication, and data-at-rest/in-transit encryption.
* Oversee vulnerability management, threat modeling, and remediation of findings identified by static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) tools.
* Appropriately assess risk when technical and architectural decisions are made, safeguarding the firm's reputation and ensuring compliance with banking regulations, auditing standards, and operational risk policies.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Talent Mentorship**
-------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Business Executives to translate complex business strategies into executable technical roadmaps and milestone plans.
* Provide technical guidance, code governance, and mentorship to Junior developers raising the technical bar of the organisation.
* Lead Technical Design Reviews (TDRs), Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and post-incident reviews (Root Cause Analysis - RCA).

**Required Qualifications & Competencies**
------------------------------------------

**Experience & Education**
--------------------------

* **Experience:** Minimum **12+ years** of progressive hands-on software engineering, distributed systems architecture, and technical leadership experience, with at least **4–6 years** in a Technical Lead / Systems Architect capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related quantitative field / equivalent work experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**
-------------------------------

**DomainCore Requirements & Proficiencies****Java & Core Technologies**• Master-level proficiency in **Java (11, 17, 21+)**, JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and multi-threaded/concurrent programming.
  

* Strong foundations in Object-Oriented Design, Functional Programming, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

**Spring Framework**• Deep architectural and development expertise with **Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration**.
  

* Proven experience designing microservice communication patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket) and service mesh implementations.

**Distributed Systems & Messaging**• Extensive experience with **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)** and message streaming platforms (**Apache Kafka**).
  

* Expert knowledge in event sourcing, CQRS patterns, distributed transaction management (Saga pattern), idempotency, and partition strategies.

**Data Architecture & Caching**• Advanced data modeling and query optimization experience with enterprise relational databases (**Oracle, PostgreSQL**) and NoSQL solutions (**MongoDB**).Expertise in distributed caching and in-memory data grids (**Redis**).

**Cloud-Native & Containerization**• Hands-on experience designing and operating containerized microservices on **Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift**
  

* Proficiency with Docker container lifecycle and Linux/Unix operating environments.

**DevOps, Observability & Tooling**• Deep knowledge of CI/CD orchestration (Jenkins, Harness, Tekton) and build automation (Maven, Gradle).
  

* Proven experience implementing full-stack observability with **Grafana, Splunk, or ELK stack**.

**Security & Quality Engineering**• Comprehensive understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, API Gateways, and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  

* Strong oversight of automated testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Pact contract testing) and security scanning (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

  
  

**Leadership & Professional Attributes**
----------------------------------------

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and gain buy-in from senior technology leaders.
* Strong strategic thinking with the capability to balance immediate tactical business needs against long-term architectural integrity.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and architectural diagramming communication skills (UML, C4 model).
* Extensive experience working in scaled Agile frameworks (Scrum / Kanban / SAFe) in a global matrix environment.

job.description:
We are a backend digital deployment hub managing a global portfolio of US-based software (SaaS) products. We are looking for a rare, highly versatile hybrid professional - someone who can write clean PHP and JavaScript code to build web scripts, but also possesses the marketing skills to run ad campaigns and the confidence to be the on-camera face of our brands.

​This is a dynamic role where you will switch between deep-focus software development and high-energy digital marketing to drive US B2B sales.

​**Your Daily Workflow:**

* ​**Web Development & Scripting:** Write, customize, and deploy PHP and JavaScript code to build commercial SaaS scripts and web applications from scratch. Manage databases and troubleshoot backend bugs.
* ​**The Revenue Engine (Ads):** Manage and optimize Meta, Google, and TikTok ad campaigns. You will analyze US market data, adjust daily budgets, and run A/B tests to drive SaaS subscriptions.
* ​**Customer Success & Support:** Act as the front-line problem solver for our US clients. Using our centralized helpdesk, you will batch-process support tickets and troubleshoot software issues.
* ​**Content Studio (On-Camera):** Script, shoot, and edit high-energy, aesthetic Reels, YouTube Shorts, and personalized video pitches targeting US B2B clients.

​**What We Are Looking For:**

* ​**The Tech Stack:** Proven experience writing custom PHP and advanced JavaScript. You must know how to build web applications, not just install WordPress themes.
* ​**Marketing Foundations:** Hands-on experience in paid digital marketing (Meta/Google Ads) and social media growth.
* ​**Exceptional On-Camera Presence:** You must be highly confident, articulate, and comfortable speaking to a camera with a professional visual presentation.
* ​**Self-Managed:** You can operate efficiently with minimal supervision, seamlessly shifting from writing code to shooting a video in the same afternoon.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend Leaning FullStack @ Rippling (KA, IN)
job.description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1.85B+** from the world’s top investors—including **Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock****, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs**—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the team**
------------------

The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling’s "Enterprise Studio" experience.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Senior** **Software Engineer Backend Leaning Full Stack** on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences.

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

**What you will do**

* Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.
* Contribute to systems that operate at scale, with exposure to distributed systems challenges and technologies such as Kafka, Flink, and AWS.
* While your strength lies in backend engineering, you will also contribute to the frontend codebase. You will write high-quality React and React Native code to ship end-to-end features and help deliver intuitive, performant UI components.
* Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, participate in thoughtful code reviews, and contribute to strong engineering standards across backend and frontend systems.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
* Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.
* Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own.
* Ability to design scalable, reliable systems and reason through trade-offs such as consistency, performance, and fault tolerance.
* Experience building reusable systems, frameworks, or developer-facing components is a plus. You should be excited by building flexible foundations that can support multiple product use cases over time.
* A track record of independently driving projects, navigating ambiguity, and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

job.description:

Required Experience, maximum: 22 years

Minimum Qualification: BE  
BTECH

* MCA

  

**Role**

**Technology Titan | Hands-on AI Enterprise Architect**

  

**Location**

Chennai | Flexibility for business travel

  

**Experience**

15+ years in technology, including 8+ years in enterprise AI/ML, GenAI or platform architecture

  

**What awaits you / Job Profile?**

* Own the enterprise AI strategy and target architecture from business-problem discovery through production deployment, adoption and measurable value realization.
* Determine when to use deterministic software, predictive ML, GenAI, retrieval-augmented generation or agentic workflows rather than applying AI by default.
* Act as a hands-on architect by building reference implementations and critical components, reviewing code and prompts, diagnosing production issues, and guiding teams through architecture and design decisions.
* Design the enterprise Agentic AI Platform, including model gateways, agent orchestration, tool and API integration, MCP-compatible connectivity, context and memory, knowledge retrieval, identity, policy enforcement, evaluation, observability and auditability.
* Lead the transition from conventional SDLC and AI-assisted SDLC to AI-DLC, embedding AI agents across discovery, requirements, architecture, engineering, testing, security, release and operations with explicit human approval gates and autonomy boundaries.
* Establish reusable AI platform capabilities, reference architectures, golden paths and engineering standards across cloud, hybrid and approved on-premises environments.
* Architect secure and production-grade AI solutions covering data pipelines, model selection, RAG, fine-tuning, multimodal experiences, inference optimization, LLMOps/MLOps, resilience, latency and cost controls.
* Embed Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual-property protection, model risk and regulatory controls into architecture and delivery workflows by design.
* Define evaluation and business KPIs for quality, groundedness, task success, safety, latency, adoption, unit economics and ROI; use evidence to decide whether to scale, redesign or stop an initiative.
Present and negotiate with product owners on platform strategy and AI risks; mentor AI engineers, data scientists, architects and product teams.

  

**What should you bring along?**

* Proven delivery of enterprise AI solutions from strategy and use-case selection through hands-on implementation, production operations and scaled adoption.
* Deep expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI and agentic systems, with sound judgment on model, data, platform and integration trade-offs.
* Strong software and platform engineering foundation across distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, cloud, DevSecOps and end-to-end lifecycle management.
* Experience leading platform and transformation programs across multiple products, teams and geographies while balancing innovation, control, reliability and cost.
* Executive-level communication, storytelling, facilitation and negotiation skills, including expectation management with CEO, COO and CTO.
* Ability to decompose ambiguous business problems, quantify value, establish a baseline and design experiments or pilots with clear exit criteria.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  

**Must-have technical skills**

* **Programming and AI engineering:**advanced Python; ML and deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn; API and microservice development.
* **GenAI architecture:**foundation-model selection, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, RAG, reranking, fine-tuning and multimodal solutions.
* **Agentic AI:** planning and reasoning patterns, tool use, multi-agent orchestration, state and memory, human-in-the-loop controls, workflow recovery, sandboxing and least-privilege execution.
* **Agent frameworks and protocols:**hands-on experience with relevant stacks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen or cloud-native agent services, plus MCP-style tool integration where appropriate.
* **Cloud AI platforms:**strong expertise in at least one of Microsoft Azure AI/Foundry, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker or Google Vertex AI, including identity, networking, security, deployment and cost architecture.
* **AI platform engineering:**Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD/CT, GitOps, model and prompt registries, experiment tracking, feature or data pipelines and artifact lineage.
* **LLMOps/MLOps and observability:**MLflow or equivalent, automated evaluation, tracing, token and latency monitoring, drift and data-quality detection, canary or shadow deployment, rollback and incident response.
* **AI evaluation and safety:**offline and online evaluation datasets, task-success and groundedness measures, hallucination and citation checks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defenses, content and tool guardrails.
* **Data and knowledge architecture:**data lakes/lakehouses, streaming with Kafka or equivalent, governance, metadata, lineage, knowledge graphs and semantic models.
* **Governance and security:**Responsible AI, privacy by design, threat modeling and familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and applicable data-protection requirements.

  

**Good-to-have technical skills**

* Experience building enterprise developer platforms or AI factories that provide reusable agent templates, evaluation harnesses, approved model catalogues and self-service deployment paths.
* Hands-on experience with open-source and commercial models, model routing, quantization, distillation, GPU capacity planning and inference optimization.

* Knowledge of advanced RAG, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, digital twins, edge AI or autonomous systems.

* Experience applying agentic approaches to software delivery, including requirements, architecture, coding, testing, security remediation, release and operations.

* Automotive or regulated-industry experience, including safety, cybersecurity, privacy and traceability expectations.

* Credentials such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer/Architect, AWS Machine Learning or Solutions Architect, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Databricks, Kubernetes or TOGAF.
